items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown from IR; expected to play vs Jets.
items.implication: Immediate high-end WR2; Berry starting as WR2.

items.text: Deebo Samuel NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY.

items.text: Steelers optimistic TE Pat Freiermuth (calf, added Sat) will play.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee if need QB; not worried about Eagles skill players with him. Start AJ Brown if active as WR2. Notes Hurts/Saquon out.

items.implication: McKee stream; AJB must; Saquon out means Pierce lead.
items.opportunity: Stable targets for Smith etc under McKee.
